presentations.more: `_dest1.images` looks up a field of parsed JSON that nothing here checked and held in `images`, and the lookup answers null or undefined when the payload leaves that field out. specs.description: `build-pieces.mjs` — Build-pieces. This project's call graph records DIRECT calls only, so a function passed to a container, destructured into an exported binding, or reached through a dynamic lookup is not one it can see. Within that limit it records no call to this module. At run time it reaches `«tag-contract»`. `writeManifest` builds `cssOf` and `buildTalkRuntime` builds `asModule`, and no requirement here is about what runs inside them. `buildIsland` has 2 failure conditions and 1 of them is stated here — the rest are in the findings in Predictable Code (the Control Center, or your editor). Can fail: “`buildIsland` can fail with the error `Error`.” 3 requirements: 3 violated. 6 stated failures.
